Enapter
Enapter is the manufacturer of the EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.

Technical Specifications Document
The document contains a table with technical specifications for the Enapter EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.

EL 4.0
The Enapter EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser is the main equipment described in the document, identified as an Anion Exchange Membrane (AEM) electrolyser. Technical specifications for the EL 4.0 are provided in the document.<SEP>The EL 4.0 is an AEM electrolyser manufactured by Enapter that produces hydrogen via water electrolysis. It features a production rate of up to 500 NL/h, an output pressure of up to 35 barg, and is fully automatic with Enapter's EMS. It conforms to CE, UKCA, and CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 standards.

Output Pressure
The EL 4.0 hydrogen output pressure is up to 35 barg.

Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 heat dissipation is 0.6 kW, beginning of life.

Production Rate
The EL 4.0 production rate is up to 500 NL/h, up to 1.0785 kg/24 h of hydrogen.

Hydrogen Output Purity
At 35 barg: 99.9% purity (< 1,000 ppm H2O and < 5 ppm O2) at 25 °C. At 8 barg: 98.8% purity (< 12,000 ppm H2O and < 5 ppm O2) at 25 °C.

Operative Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 operative power consumption is 2.4 kW, beginning of life.

Nominal Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 nominal power consumption is 4.8 kWh/Nm3 of H2 produced, beginning of life.

Peak Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 peak power consumption is 3 kW.

Max Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 maximum heat dissipation is 0.9 kW, end of life.

Standby Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 standby power consumption is 0.3 kW.

Power Supply
The EL 4.0 requires a power supply of 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz.

Water Consumption
The EL 4.0 water consumption is approximately 420 mL/h at 25 °C.

Maximum Water Input Conductivity
The EL 4.0 requires a minimum water input conductivity of ASTM D1193-06 Type IV or recommended Type II or Type III.

Water Input Pressure Range
The EL 4.0 water input pressure range is 1 – 4 barg.

Ambient Operative Temperature Range
The EL 4.0 ambient operative temperature range is 5 °C – 45 °C.

Ambient Operative Humidity Range
The EL 4.0 ambient operative humidity range is up to 90% humidity, non-condensing.

IP Rating
The EL 4.0 has an IP 20 rating, indicating protection against solid objects larger than 12.5 mm and no protection against water.
